A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose an efficient algorithm that can be used to predict temporal links.

we propose an approach for temporal knowledge base completion, which uses a tensor decomposition to learn latent representations of entities and relations, and which is capable of handling temporal constraints on queries.
we propose a new temporal knowledge graph embedding model based on tensor factorization.
The main takeaway from our work is that

temporal knowledge bases are best represented by a tensor of order 4, where the first two modes correspond to entities, the third mode corresponds to relations, and the last mode corresponds to time intervals.
tensor factorization is a powerful tool for temporal knowledge base completion that can be used to answer queries with temporal constraints.
the temporal dimension can be modeled by an additional order-4 tensor, which can be decomposed using a variant of the canonical polyadic decomposition (CPD) that we call temporal CPD.
